Container.Name: minsnooks
Container.Overview: Minsnooks V2 — family snooker league app (SvelteKit + SQLite), designed to sit behind Cloudflare Access. Keep this isolated from any V1 (dougalbob/snooker-league) container, hostname, or appdata. See docs/deployment.md in the repository for full environment-variable and Cloudflare Access setup notes.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port mapped to the container's internal HTTP port (PORT below). Point your reverse proxy / Cloudflare Tunnel at this.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite database (DATABASE_PATH must live under this path). Use a dedicated appdata folder, separate from any V1 data.

Config.Name: NODE_ENV
Config.Description: Node environment. Always production for a real deployment.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Port the Node server listens on inside the container. Match WebUI Port's container-side value if you change this.

Config.Name: DATABASE_PATH
Config.Description: SQLite database file path. Must be under the AppData mount above so it survives container recreation.

Config.Name: ORIGIN
Config.Description: Public HTTPS origin players use, e.g. https://snooker-v2.example.com. Required for SvelteKit's form-action CSRF/origin check behind a reverse proxy or Cloudflare — omitting this breaks every POST (results, bookings, chat, etc.).

Config.Name: AUTH_MODE
Config.Description: Must be 'access' for any Internet-reachable deployment. Never 'dev' here.

Config.Name: CF_TEAM_DOMAIN
Config.Description: Your Cloudflare Access team domain, e.g. yourteam.cloudflareaccess.com. Use a team/application separate from any existing V1 Access app.

Config.Name: CF_AUD
Config.Description: The Cloudflare Access application's AUD tag (Access application -> Overview).

Config.Name: ACCESS_EMAIL_ALLOWLIST
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of approved league member email addresses. The app fails closed if this is empty.

Config.Name: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
Config.Description: Optional: web push public key. Leave blank to disable push (in-app notifications still work). Generate a fresh key pair for this deployment.

Config.Name: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY
Config.Description: Optional: web push private key. Keep secret; never reuse a development key pair.

Config.Name: VAPID_SUBJECT
Config.Description: Optional: contact URI for push, e.g. mailto:admin@example.com.
